title: AscensionCrafter — spell database browser
description: Browsing convenience only (Phase 1 T9) — explicitly not the builder app. Query surfaces: spell_mechanics (resolved numbers + provenance) and spell_relationships (interactions). Rebuild with: py cli/rebuild.py

resolved_mechanics_for_spell.title: What are this spell's resolved numbers, with provenance?

what_amplifies_this.sql: SELECT r.source_spell_id, s.name, r.relation_type, r.magnitude, r.magnitude_unit, r.confidence, r.evidence_ref FROM spell_relationships r LEFT JOIN spells s ON s.id = r.source_spell_id WHERE r.target_spell_id = :spell_id AND r.relation_type IN ('amplifies','borrows_modifiers','amplifies_school')
what_amplifies_this.title: Everything that amplifies a spell (graph edition)

trigger_attributed_magnitudes.sql: SELECT source_spell_id, via, flat_min, flat_max, per_level, evidence_ref FROM spell_effect_values WHERE spell_id = :spell_id AND via LIKE 'trigger_hop%'
trigger_attributed_magnitudes.title: A card's trigger-attributed magnitudes (chain in evidence_ref)

owned_by_school.sql: SELECT s.id, s.name, oc.pool, oc.rank FROM owned_cards oc JOIN spells s ON s.id = oc.spellId WHERE (',' || COALESCE(s.schools,'') || ',') LIKE '%,' || :school || ',%' ORDER BY s.name
owned_by_school.title: What do I own that does <school> damage?

top_coefficients_by_term.sql: SELECT s.name, ss.term_type, ss.coefficient, ss.source, ss.rank, ss.cp_scaling_type FROM spell_scaling ss LEFT JOIN spells s ON s.id = ss.spell_id WHERE ss.term_type = :term ORDER BY ss.coefficient DESC LIMIT 50
top_coefficients_by_term.title: Highest coefficients for a scaling term (SP/AP/SPFR/...) — ⚠ check rank, Rank-1 rows ramp

chase_list_exclusivity_conflicts.sql: SELECT eb1.bucket_name, s1.name AS card_a, s2.name AS card_b FROM exclusivity_buckets eb1 JOIN exclusivity_buckets eb2 ON eb1.bucket_id = eb2.bucket_id AND eb1.spell_id < eb2.spell_id JOIN spells s1 ON s1.id = eb1.spell_id JOIN spells s2 ON s2.id = eb2.spell_id
chase_list_exclusivity_conflicts.title: Exclusivity-bucket conflicts (does-not-stack pairs)

open_questions_queue.sql: SELECT slug, question, blocks, status, affected_spell_ids, opened_at FROM open_questions WHERE status IN ('open','in_progress') ORDER BY opened_at DESC
open_questions_queue.title: The verification queue — what's still unknown

retraction_history.sql: SELECT slug, claim, what_falsified_it, superseding_fact_topic, retracted_at FROM retractions ORDER BY retracted_at DESC
retraction_history.title: Everything this project has been wrong about, and why

facts_touching_spell.sql: SELECT f.topic, f.fact, l.match_method, l.confidence FROM fact_spell_links l JOIN confirmed_facts f ON f.topic = l.fact_topic WHERE l.spell_id = :spell_id
facts_touching_spell.title: Confirmed facts linked to a spell (name links are needs_review)

recently_patched_spells.sql: SELECT p.patch_date, pes.spell_id, pes.matched_name, pe.change_direction, pe.status, substr(pe.raw_text,1,160) AS text FROM patch_entry_spells pes JOIN patch_entries pe ON pe.entry_id = pes.entry_id JOIN patches p ON p.patch_id = pe.patch_id ORDER BY p.patch_date DESC LIMIT 100
recently_patched_spells.title: Recently patched spells (Darkmoon)

mechanics_conflicts.sql: SELECT spell_id, rank, confidence, conflicts_json FROM spell_mechanics WHERE confidence = 'conflict'
mechanics_conflicts.title: Mechanics conflicts — surfaced, never auto-resolved (§2.3)

rank_gap_spot_check.sql: SELECT r.spell_id, r.name, r.rank, r.spell_level FROM dbc_spell_rank r WHERE r.line_id = (SELECT line_id FROM dbc_spell_rank WHERE spell_id = :spell_id) ORDER BY r.rank
rank_gap_spot_check.title: A spell's full rank line (level-60 casts the highest rank with spell_level <= 60)
